Id=ssh.service
User=
ExecStart={ path=/usr/sbin/sshd ; argv[]=/usr/sbin/sshd -D $SSHD_OPTS ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
ExecStartPre={ path=/usr/sbin/sshd ; argv[]=/usr/sbin/sshd -t ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
ExecStartPost=
WorkingDirectory=
EnvironmentFiles=/etc/default/ssh (ignore_errors=yes)
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/system/ssh.service
DropInPaths=

Id=example-indexer.service
User=
ExecStart={ path=/usr/bin/python3 ; argv[]=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/operator/indexer/run.py --quiet ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
ExecStartPre=
ExecStartPost=
WorkingDirectory=/home/operator/indexer
EnvironmentFiles=
FragmentPath=/etc/systemd/system/example-indexer.service
DropInPaths=/run/systemd/system/example-indexer.service.d/50-refresh.conf
